description: The Contractor shall provide all management, tools, equipment, and labor necessary to ensure that custodial services are performed at Yokota Air Base, Japan, in a manner that will maintain a satisfactory facility condition and present a clean, neat and professional appearance. The Contractor shall accomplish all cleaning tasks and be required to replenish soap and paper products in all restrooms in order to meet the requirements of this Performance-based Work Statement (PWS) and the Service Summary (SS). All work performed by the Contractor shall be performed in accordance with all applicable laws, regulations, Headquarters Air Force standards, instructions, and commercial practices.
